description: Source code for the MenuContentView SwiftUI view in the OpenClaw macOS application. Defines the UI and behavior of the menu content, including connection status, microphone management, and debug options.

classes.name: MenuContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct providing the content for the application menu bar extra, including connection controls, status indicators, microphone management, and debug options.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the SwiftUI view hierarchy for the menu content, including toggles, buttons, and status lines, managing various states and actions.

methods.name: loadMicrophones
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers and loads available microphone devices, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: saveBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Saves the enabled/disabled state of browser control to persistent configuration.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Navigates to a specific application settings tab and activates the NSApp window.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Opens the dashboard URL in the default web browser, handling errors with an alert.
